bibliographic.title: Formação docente e competências digitais na era da dataficação: Uma análise crítico-sistêmica das mediações entre inteligência artificial, governança educacional e prática pedagógica
bibliographic.authors: Luiz Fernando Ridolfi; Andréa da Silva Santos leite; Luciana Maria Nickel Candeias; Wadiswava Dias Rezende; Dominick Figueiredo; Graziani Vasconcelos Zanfolin; Charles Alves Correia; Emanuele Martins Teles; Maria José Cunha Freire Mendes

Formação docente e competências digitais na era da dataficação: Uma análise crítico-sistêmica das mediações entre inteligência artificial, governança educacional e prática pedagógica. Revista não identificada no texto, 13(04), 1–29. https://doi.org/10.66104/5nyz8e97

methodology.method_family: qualitative theoretical-analytical systematized literature review with PRISMA-inspired selection
methodology.study_design: systematized literature review (2020–2025) using SciELO, ERIC, CAPES and Google Scholar
methodology.sample_description: recent literature on teacher digital competencies, educational governance, dataification and AI in education, selected by theoretical relevance, methodological rigor and critical educational field adherence
methodology.technology_context: generic artificial intelligence, adaptive systems and educational algorithms in digital/datafied education; no explicit LLM, chatbot, agent, RAG or conversational system focus

eligibility.decision_rationale: The article is a PRISMA-inspired systematized review on teacher digital competencies linking AI and educational governance in datafied education. It offers contextual evidence on governance, monitoring and institutional/policy dimensions in education, but the provided text does not address conversational AI, LLMs, chatbots, agents, guardrails, observability, audit logs, human oversight mechanisms, or operational governance of generative conversational systems.
eligibility.manual_spotcheck_reason: Triagem Python classificou como central_candidate por termos amplos de governança e IA; é necessário confirmar manualmente se o texto completo contém menções a LLMs, sistemas conversacionais ou governança operacional/técnica ausentes nos trechos fornecidos.

appraisal.notes: Objective and review design are clearly stated in the abstract. Selection across multiple databases and n=38 are reported, but full search strategy, screening flow, quality appraisal of included studies and reflexivity/ethics are not evidenced in the excerpts provided. Relevance to the review's LLM conversational governance focus is limited.

cerqual.explanation: Moderate confidence that the study adequately synthesizes educational governance and generic AI in teacher training, but low relevance to conversational LLM governance because the provided text focuses on datafication, teacher digital competence and educational governance rather than conversational systems or operational AI controls.

coding.theme: Educational governance and teacher digital competence in the age of datafication and generic AI
coding.subtheme: Institutional, formative and pedagogical mediations between AI and teaching practice

synthesis.main_claim: Teacher digital competence is a multidimensional phenomenon shaped by structural, formative and institutional conditions, and the integration of AI and digital technologies in education reconfigures educational governance while posing risks to teacher autonomy unless supported by systemic, critical approaches.
synthesis.contribution: Provides a critical-systemic literature synthesis connecting AI, educational governance and teacher practice in datafied education, useful as contextual background for regulated education settings but not as direct evidence on conversational LLM governance.
synthesis.limitations: Provided excerpts do not document full PRISMA reporting, independent quality appraisal of included studies, or any LLM/conversational-system operational governance mechanisms; the presented table is explicitly non-exhaustive of the n=38 corpus.
synthesis.use_in_review: Include as foundational/contextual evidence for education-sector governance, monitoring and policy tensions around AI-mediated teaching; do not treat as central evidence for conversational LLM governance, guardrails, observability, auditability or human oversight in chat/agent systems.
